svg.title: A hospitalized client is going for an MRI of the brain. Which actions does the nurse take before the client leaves the unit? Select all that apply.
svg.desc: The MRI magnet pulls in ferrous metal : snaps, oxygen cylinders and older pacemakers are hazards, so the nurse completes the MRI safety screening and removes or swaps them. Standard telemetry leads must be changed to MRI-compatible ones, and an MRI takes much longer than a CT, so the client should be told to expect a long time lying still.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Neurologic Dysfunction &
Cerebrovascular Disorders
Read the situation
A hospitalized client is going for an MRI
of the brain. Which actions does the nurse
take before the client leaves the unit?
Select all that apply.
What fits here
Replace the gown that has metal snaps ·
Move the client from the portable oxygen
cylinder to an MRI-safe oxygen source ·
Ask whether the client has an older
pacemaker or other implanted…
Why it fits
The MRI magnet pulls in ferrous metal :
snaps, oxygen cylinders and older
pacemakers are hazards, so the nurse
completes the MRI safety screening and
removes or swaps them.
